entry.title: New: Resolution 317 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPROVES THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A SISTER CITY RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I AND HATSUKAICHI, HIROSHIMA PREFECTURE, JAPAN, AND AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I TO ENTER INTO A FORMAL SIGNED AGREEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to formally establish this sister-city relationship, pursuant to Section 2-165 of the Hawai‘i County Code.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 317-23 & GOEAC-80 – 11/15/23
